summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an attached Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules. The filing reports a routine conversion of 711,481 Class B ordinary shares into Class A ordinary shares, effective April 24, 2026. Class A shares are listed on the Hong Kong Exchange (stock code 02015); Class B shares are unlisted. No buyback, tender offer, spin-off, or strategic event occurred. The conversion does not change total equity, only the split between share classes. This is a standard administrative disclosure with no deal terms, premium, or special-situation trigger. It does not represent an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or any other special situation.
